title: Characterization of an All-Ones Word
statement: For every finite Boolean word $p$ and natural number $n$, $p$ consists entirely of ones and has length $n$ if and only if $p$ is the all-ones word of length $n$.
replaced: For every binary word $p$ and natural number $n$: $p$ is the all-ones word of its own length and $|p| = n$, if and only if $p$ is the all-ones word of length $n$.
